items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: And she called, well, you know, Sharon's been listening.

ctx.x: And he's a very nice guy. And then we had to stop and he said, man, I have a brother. And she called, well, you know, Sharon's been listening. And he got there, gave him a buzz and told me he met me. And he's a very pleasant guy. I didn't see him this time yet. I haven't seen him. I haven't seen him either. But a very nice guy. He's very sharp.
Well, what about Johnny? How did he get interested in music? Do you know? Was he interested? Who? Johnny Dodge. Did you know him when he got interested?
